data: More room for the grid and saved Obsidian sheets
Expand from the toolbar and save a sheet copy when you send to Obsidian.

Click Expand to see more columns. Notes can stay open while the window fills the usable display. Click Compact to return to your previous size. Grid and shortcuts.

Send to Obsidian saves the sheet too. A full send updates the dated copy in Scratch/Sheets and adds the table and notes to today’s daily note. The selection command still sends just the selected range and notes. Notes and Obsidian.
